description: A small kit for cuts, sprains, and burns.

name: Painkillers

description: An auto-injector. One scene of borrowed speed, then a price.

description: A bottle of antiseptic. Clean work saves more lives than brave work.

description: Sterile cloth, a scalpel, forceps, and a suture kit.
